Hijri don dɔ don walasa ka Arafah, An-Nahr ani Tashreeq donw sɔrɔ
Aw ye Hijri don dɔ don walasa ka Arafah, An-Nahr ani Tashreeq donw ye
Hijri don min bɛ se ka kɛ, o sɛbɛn. San bɛ daminɛ 1300 na ka se 1600 ma, kalo bɛ daminɛ 1 na ka se 12 ma, tile bɛ daminɛ 1 na ka se 30 ma.

Hijri don o don sɛbɛn (walima ka don min bɛ sen na sisan) walasa ka a san ka Haji donw sɔrɔ o yɔrɔnin bɛɛ: Arafa don (Dhul-Hijjah 9), An-Nahr don (Dhul-Hijjah 10) ani Tashreeq donw (Dhul-Hijjah 11, 12 ani 13), u kelen-kelen bɛɛ n’u ka gregorian bɔɲɔgɔnko ani u jɔyɔrɔ ka kɛɲɛ ni i ka don ye.
Yala nin don yɛrɛ de don wa
Pilari belebeleba: jɔ Arafah la k’a ta midi kɔfɛ fo ka se tilebin ma, ka delili caman kɛ, takbir ani tahlil. Nabila (SAW) ko: "Haji ye Arafa ye."
Eid al-Adha: ka Jamarat al-Aqabah kabakurun ni kabakurun wolonwula ye, ka saraka kɛ, ka a kunsigi tigɛ walima ka a tigɛ, o kɔfɛ ka Tawaf al-Ifadah ni Sai kɛ.
Don o don kunnafoni min b’aw hakili jigin seli laɲininen na a waati la Haji donw na (8–13 Zul-Hijjah)

Nin don in sunna: don ihram kɔnɔ, ka taa Mina ka su kɛ yen, ka segin Talbiyah "Labbayk Allahumma labbayk" kan, ka delili kɛ yen ka surunya k\'a sɔrɔ i ma fara ɲɔgɔn kan.
Jamara saba kabakurunw kɛ tilelafana kɔfɛ: fitinin, o kɔfɛ cɛmancɛ, o kɔfɛ belebele, kabakurun wolonwula kelen-kelen k’a to takbir fɔli la, ka delili kɛ fitininw ni cɛmancɛw kɔfɛ.
Aw bɛ segin ka kabakurun ci Jamara saba ma tilelafana kɔfɛ i n’a fɔ kunun. Mɔgɔ o mɔgɔ b’a fɛ ka teliya, o bɛ se ka bɔ Mina sanni tile ka bin; min tora, o bɛ su kɛ ka kabakurunw ci tile sabanan na.
Kabakurun kɛ Jamara saba la midi kɔfɛ, o kɔfɛ, ka Haji kuncɛ ni farali Tawaf ye n’i bɔra Makka. Allah ka sɔn i ka Haji ma.

Haji ni Umrah ka ɲɛfɔli bɛɛ lajɛlen : ɲɛfɔli ni kiritigɛlaw, laadalakow suguyaw, mawaqit, laadalakow senfɛ-senfɛ n’u hakilitigiya ye ani min bɛ fɔ garasi kelen-kelen bɛɛ la, ihrama balili, ani delili. I b’a fɛ ka yɔrɔ min sɛgɛsɛgɛ, i k’o sugandi.
